name: EPIC 201794967
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 1, 20.7 solar radii and 1.05 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

radius.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 201794967 (K2 campaign 1): PARAM radius (solar radii) 20.652954 (16th-84th percentiles 19.463019-21.973224), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

distance.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 201794967 (K2 campaign 1): PARAM asteroseismic distance (pc) 3101.757812 (16th-84th percentiles 2954.570312-3255.664062), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

text.card: A red giant 3,102 parsecs away, 21 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 1, give 1.05 solar masses and 20.7 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,454 K at its surface.
